notes.title: Trading cards have arrived!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34906522/56c2dca68bfcb057bc7137d5f77682f6929a7433.png

Ladies and gentlemen, it's finally here ー that's right, it's what you've all been waiting for! 
Today marks the arrival of Rabbit Burn trading cards on Steam! What better way to splash some chaos onto your profile page? 

Try to collect as many as you can!:drgegeru::lickymeowmeow::magmadino::rabbitman::sarah_bunny:
